metadata.description: A SECONDARY ENTRY POINT of @dereekb/dbx-form, not a package of its own: it compiles into dist/packages/dbx-form/quiz and is named by that package's dist `exports` under "./quiz".  It has no build target, and that is deliberate. ng-packagr's discoverPackages globs `**/ng-package.json` under packages/dbx-form and builds every match as a secondary entry point, so `dbx-form:build-base` ALONE already writes this directory.  A standalone build-base here was a DUPLICATE WRITER of dbx-form's dist -- and worse, running it standalone made ng-packagr treat this as a PRIMARY entry point, which falls back to the schema default `dest: "dist"` and wrote a stray packages/dbx-form/quiz/dist/ next to the source.  Consumers still resolve correctly: @nx/js updatePaths binds "@dereekb/dbx-form/quiz" to dist/packages/dbx-form/quiz off the PARENT dependency's outputs (its "check for secondary entrypoints" pass), and `^build` onto a project with no `build` creates a dummy task and recurses to its dependencies, landing on `dbx-form:build`.
